caption: The drawing shows a single, oval-shaped box with a slightly domed lid. The box is decorated with designs in green and white on a tan, yellow-brown background. On the sides and top of the box are images of birds perched on large, ornate containers resembling urns or vases, surrounded by foliage and garland-like patterns. The upper edge of the box features a decorative border with alternating green and blue markings on a light band. The box has visible creases, wrinkles, and areas where the surface appears worn or torn. There is a shadow beneath the box, indicating light coming from the upper left. The drawing is executed in watercolor, with soft edges and blended colors, and is signed “Holger Hansen” in the bottom right corner.
title: Bandbox
